name: Bluetile x Nike SB Dunk 'Black Marina White'
story_html: Designed in partnership with the South Carolina skate shop, the Bluetile x Nike SB Dunk 'Black Marina White' draws inspiration from the monarch butterfly. Fuzzy laces secure the upper, which combines a shimmering Pitch Blue leather base with coated black suede overlays at the forefoot and heel. The latter is de-stitched and features butterfly wing graphics printed on the interior side. A subtle hexagonal print covers a teal blue Swoosh that is raised to mimic the look of butterfly eyes. Orange embroidered detailing is found beneath the heel tab, marked with 'Blue' and 'Tile' on the left and right shoes. Underfoot, the translucent rubber outsole reveals a blue and orange gradient that denotes the setting sun.
